issues: P2 — Stale terminal readiness can become current campaign readiness. In Master.reconcile_campaign_invocation, runner.lock protects validation of the completed manifest, but current state and proposal evidence are never revalidated. After a campaign run reports proposal_reviewed_implementation_held, a serialized ordinary invocation can invalidate proposal acceptance before reconciliation. Reconciliation still consumes the historical result and sets status='proposal_ready'; campaign then exits and returns that status. This bypasses the current-evidence check implemented for the separate cached-proposal_ready startup path. Preserve the completed invocation and its progress exactly once, but before publishing campaign readiness, reload state and validate current protection and proposal_gate under runner.lock. If current evidence fails, retain the historical success while recording needs_supervisor_repair with the current failure reason. Add a regression that interposes an ordinary invocation invalidating proposal evidence between terminal run publication and reconciliation.
next_actions: Implement current-evidence validation when reconciliation promotes the campaign to proposal_ready, without rewriting historical invocation evidence.
Run the targeted stale-readiness regression and existing campaign reconciliation tests, then obtain a fresh bounded review.
